long_biography.plain_text:
Continent and Cascade sit at the centre of Valery Kokorin’s commercial-property portfolio. Through ASK, he combined construction with ownership and operation of large shopping and entertainment complexes in Omsk. He retained a controlling interest in Continent while extending the business into hotels and cinemas.

ASK’s work also reached far beyond retail. It delivered religious buildings, an oncology surgical block, industrial premises, housing and cultural facilities across the Omsk region. Kokorin carried that local-development role into elected office, serving terms in both the regional legislature and Omsk city council. His public career has made regional development a sustained part of his work beyond the properties themselves.
